name: BSBTBZ Pink Bow French Tip Press-On Nails

cardLine: Pink bows give square French tips a romantic twist.
description: These BSBTBZ press-on nails pair square French tips with pink bow decorations and a glossy, sparkly finish. The ready-made design offers a romantic detail for outfits built around pink accents or coordinating bow accessories.
whyWePicked: The combination of square French tips and pink bows makes a familiar manicure style feel distinctly coquette.
